description: Job search to new job; a three-week gap in the middle where he stops talking.

key.change: job search -> offer (Sep 20) -> accepted (Sep 22) -> joined Oct 6 at Zenith Labs
key.gap: no conversations between Sep 22 and Oct 12
key.event: first day Oct 6, reported Oct 12: overwhelming but good

messages: Hi, I'm Vikram. My contract at a consulting firm ended last month and I'm looking for a job.
I'm a backend developer, mostly Java.
Money is getting tight and it's stressing me out.
Okay, that's all for now.
Applied to twelve companies today.
I keep checking my bank app and it's making me anxious.
Good night.
Went for a run to clear my head.
My friend offered to refer me to his company.
Talk soon.
I had a first-round interview today, it went decently.
I'm counting every expense now, it's stressful.
Bye for now.
Two rejections came in today.
I'm trying not to spiral about my savings.
That's all.
A company called Zenith Labs wants a second round with their tech lead.
It's a backend role with a good team.
Good night.
Zenith Labs gave me an offer today.
I'm so relieved, I almost didn't believe it.
I'll take a day to read the details.
I accepted the offer at Zenith Labs.
My start date is October 6.
I'll go quiet for a bit, I have a trip with family before I start.
Talk when I'm back.
I'm back. I started at Zenith Labs on October 6.
The first week was overwhelming but the team is kind.
I'm learning their codebase one service at a time.
I shipped my first small fix today.
Money feels less scary now that a salary is coming.
Good night.
Went for a long run on the weekend.
I'm planning to join a local running group.
Thanks for listening.

probes.question: Where do I work now?
probes.expected: Zenith Labs (joined October 6); no longer job hunting.

probes.question: Has anything about me changed since we first started talking?
probes.expected: Should mention: from unemployed/job hunting to employed at Zenith Labs; money worry eased.

probes.question: Is my worry about money a recurring worry or a one-off? Answer RECURRING or ONE-OFF, and state your confidence as HIGH, MEDIUM or LOW.
probes.expected: RECURRING, confidence HIGH (4 conversations), though it has eased since the job.

probes.question: How was my first week at the new job?
probes.expected: Overwhelming but the team is kind; he is learning the codebase.

probes.question: What kind of developer am I, and which language do I mostly use?
